title: Azure Monitor Overview
description: Explore Azure Monitor and understand how it collects, analyzes, and acts on telemetry from Azure resources.

data.text: Azure Monitor is the central platform for observability in Azure. It collects data from every Azure resource, your applications, and the underlying operating system. You can visualize data in dashboards, set alerts, and run automated responses.

terms.definition: A suite of services for collecting, analyzing, and acting on telemetry data from Azure resources.
Numeric data measured at regular intervals, stored in the Monitor Metrics database.
Rich, structured data stored in Log Analytics workspaces, queried with KQL.
Automated notifications or actions triggered when a metric or log query meets a condition.
Automatic adjustment of resource capacity based on metrics and rules.

data.title: Enable Azure Monitor for a Resource (Azure CLI)
data.content: Enable diagnostic settings to send metrics and logs to Log Analytics:
data.code:
az monitor diagnostic-settings create \
  --resource-group myResourceGroup \
  --name send-to-log-analytics \
  --resource $(az webapp show -g myResourceGroup -n myApp --query id -o tsv) \
  --workspace $(az monitor log-analytics workspace show -g myResourceGroup -n myWorkspace --query id -o tsv) \
  --logs "[{\"category\": \"AppServiceConsoleLogs\", \"enabled\": true}]" \
  --metrics "[{\"category\": \"AllMetrics\", \"enabled\": true}]"

data.caption: Azure Monitor data flow
data.definition:
graph TD
    R[Azure Resources] --> M[Metrics Explorer]
    R --> D[Diagnostic Settings]
    D --> LA[Log Analytics Workspace]
    D --> S[Storage Account]
    D --> EH[Event Hub]
    M --> DASH[Azure Dashboard]
    LA --> KQL[KQL Queries]
    KQL --> ALERT[Alert Rules]
    ALERT --> A[Action Group
    Email, SMS, Webhook]

data.title: Monitor at Every Layer
data.text: Azure Monitor works across layers: infrastructure (VMs, disks), platform (App Service, SQL), and application (code, dependencies). Collecting data at all three layers gives you end-to-end visibility.

data.title: Enable Monitoring for an App Service
data.description: Configure diagnostic settings for an Azure App Service.
steps: Enable system-assigned managed identity for the App Service.
Create a Log Analytics workspace in the same region.
Configure diagnostic settings to send AppServiceConsoleLogs and AppServiceHTTPLogs to the workspace.
Verify data appears in Log Analytics within 10 minutes.
data.expectedOutcome: App Service logs are flowing into your Log Analytics workspace.
